linear_models.regularization: MANDATORY (L1 Lasso, L2 Ridge, or ElasticNet)

decision_tree_ensembles.rationale: Deep trees will isolate single data points and memorize noise; shallow depth prevents sample fragmentation.

gaussian_processes.rationale: Gaussian processes provide closed-form Bayesian uncertainty estimation naturally robust to small N.

symbolic_regression.rationale: High node complexity results in non-physical polynomial fitting.

mitigation_protocol: Strict feature selection to top 3-4 physical descriptors
Regularization penalties on all parametric models
